articles.title: Angela Nakamura, 67, Machinist
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Nakamura for the many years of service to Mill Hill.
body: Born in Mill Hill in the years after the war, Angela Nakamura spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Angela Nakamura died in January at home on Harbor Terrace, at the age of 67.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Mill Hill. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to St. Brendan’s Parish in his or her name.
